interface.signature: width: int, height: int, x_coords: List[int], y_coords: List[int]) -> List[List[int]]

preconditions.description: Width and height must be non-negative integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < width for x in x_coords)
preconditions.description: All x coordinates must be within the map's width.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= y < height for y in y_coords)
preconditions.description: All y coordinates must be within the map's height.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None if len(x_coords) == 0 or len(y_coords) == 0 else True
postconditions.description: If there are no supply points, return None in every cell.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: The return value must be a list of lists.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == width for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each row in the return value must have the same width as the map.
The return value must have the same height as the map.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cell, int) for row in return_value for cell in row)
postconditions.description: Each cell in the return value must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(cell >= 0 for row in return_value for cell in row)
postconditions.description: Each cell in the return value must represent a non-negative distance.

postconditions.expression: all(cell == min(abs(x - xi) + abs(y - yi) for xi in x_coords for yi in y_coords) for y in range(height) for x in range(width))
postconditions.description: Each cell must contain the Manhattan distance to the closest supply point.
